attacks.claim: In the default light theme the embargo badge text is #ffffff on a background of var(--surface), which is #ffffff in light. The badge text is invisible, so the feature fails for most users. The hardcoded white only works in dark. It also fails WCAG contrast.

The unpublish control is a plain span with only an onClick. It has no button role, no tabindex and no key handler, so keyboard-only editors cannot reach or activate it. This fails WCAG 2.1.1, which is a release requirement.

The control is icon-only with the icon aria-hidden and no accessible name or role. Screen-reader users cannot discover or identify it, which fails WCAG 4.1.2. Using a real <button> with an aria-label would fix this and the keyboard problem together.
attacks.evidence: <TrashIcon aria-hidden="true" />  (no aria-label or visually hidden text)

attacks.claim: There is no :focus-visible style for the unpublish control. Once it is made focusable, keyboard focus will be invisible.
If onUnpublish rejects, DraftRow has no error handling or feedback. The caller may handle it, but that code is not in the diff.
A trash icon suggests deletion, not unpublish, for a live story.
The embargo check uses the client clock, so skew can show the wrong state. The badge also shows no timezone label.
No tests are shown for the embargo badge, the timezone rendering, or the unpublish confirm, cancel and error paths.
